name: Jeeter | Blueberry Kush | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Blueberry Kush is an indica strain that brings together the legendary Blueberry and OG Kush for a mix that’s both fruity and classic. Its flavor stays true to the name, serving up sweet blueberry notes layered with a little earthy depth and herbal richness. Smooth on the inhale and bold on the exhale, this strain has the kind of taste that sticks with you. If you’re into berries with a little attitude, light up a Blueberry Kush Jeeter and let the flavor do the talking.
